name: Crone
title: Crone Archetypes
summary: Ending and elderhood; the task is to release, reveal, and transmit hard-won wisdom.
essence: Truth beyond approval, reverence for cycles, and service free of the need to be central.

archetypes.name: Crone

profile.coreFunction: Release what has ended while preserving its grief, learning, and continuity.
profile.keyQualities: Truthful, Fearless, Catalytic, Sovereign, Compassionate, Deep, Transformative, Clear, Mystic, Liberating

archetypes.coreFunction: Release what has ended while preserving its grief, learning, and continuity.

bodySections.heading: Definition
bodySections.content:
The Mature Crone knows what must die, what must be mourned, and what can be carried onward in changed form. She neither sterilizes grief nor builds a home inside it. By remembering truly and releasing fully, she returns the past to the soil of future life.

The underworld-queen current: ending, composting, grief, and the threshold of renewal.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- I release the form and keep the wisdom.
- Grief honors what mattered and makes movement possible.
- An ending can be exact without being cruel.
- I let the past become soil, not residence.

bodySections.heading: Balance
bodySections.content:
Release and Remembrance are mutually correcting.

Release ends attachment to forms whose life or season is complete.

Remembrance preserves meaning, lineage, and learning across the threshold of loss.

bodySections.heading: Applications
bodySections.content: Release what is finished while carrying forward its truth and nourishment.

bodySections.heading: Gifts, Responsibilities, and Challenges
bodySections.content: The underworld-queen current: ending, composting, grief, and the threshold of renewal.

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- Name what must end and what deserves to be remembered.
- Create a small ritual that marks an irreversible transition.

bodySections.heading: Living as the Crone
bodySections.content: The Mature Crone knows what must die, what must be mourned, and what can be carried onward in changed form. She neither sterilizes grief nor builds a home inside it. By remembering truly and releasing fully, she returns the past to the soil of future life.

profile.keyQualities: Uses total severance as first response, Rewrites the past as worthless, Destroys supports needed for transition

bodySections.heading: Balance Breakdown
bodySections.content: Release scorches without remembrance.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- If it is flawed, it must be ended completely.
- Looking back only weakens resolve.
- I owe the past nothing.

bodySections.heading: Psychological Mechanics
bodySections.content: Release abandons remembrance and becomes indiscriminate severing. She burns relationships, roles, or histories at the first scent of decay, mistaking destruction for transformation. Nothing can teach or compost when it is denied all value.

bodySections.heading: Hidden Energy
bodySections.content: Her fearlessness becomes clean closure when it makes space without erasing meaning.

bodySections.heading: Recognition
bodySections.content:
Uses total severance as first response

Rewrites the past as worthless

Destroys supports needed for transition

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- Separate what must end from what can be retained.
- Grieve before making irreversible cuts.
- Carry one lesson or blessing across the threshold.

bodySections.heading: Opposite Shadow
bodySections.content: Relic Keeper is the opposite imbalance of Release + Remembrance.

bodySections.heading: Transformation
bodySections.content: Integration restores Remembrance and the dynamic relationship between Release and Remembrance. Preserve learning; permit ending.

bodySections.heading: Conclusion
bodySections.content: Her fearlessness becomes clean closure when it makes space without erasing meaning.

profile.keyQualities: Keeps expired commitments, Organizes identity around loss, Resists new life as betrayal

bodySections.heading: Balance Breakdown
bodySections.content: Release collapses while remembrance becomes preservation.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- Letting go would mean it did not matter.
- I must keep this exactly as it was.
- Moving on is disloyal.

bodySections.heading: Psychological Mechanics
bodySections.content: Release fails as remembrance hardens into preservation. She maintains dead roles, loyalties, and identities because letting them end feels like betrayal. The past is honored so completely that it cannot become nourishment for the present.

bodySections.heading: Hidden Energy
bodySections.content: Her fidelity becomes ancestral wisdom when memory can travel without the corpse of the old form.

bodySections.heading: Recognition
bodySections.content:
Keeps expired commitments

Organizes identity around loss

Resists new life as betrayal

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- Distinguish memory from continued obligation.
- Choose a finite form for honoring what ended.
- Make one present-tense commitment after grieving.

bodySections.heading: Opposite Shadow
bodySections.content: Scorched-Earth Crone is the opposite imbalance of Release + Remembrance.

bodySections.heading: Transformation
bodySections.content: Integration restores Release and the dynamic relationship between Release and Remembrance. Preserve learning; permit ending.

bodySections.heading: Conclusion
bodySections.content: Her fidelity becomes ancestral wisdom when memory can travel without the corpse of the old form.

archetypes.name: Witness

profile.coreFunction: Compassionately accompany suffering at the limit of cure or control without owning outcome or turning away.
profile.keyQualities: Compassionate, Boundaried, Wise, Restorative, Devotional, Grounded, Humble, Ethical, Steady, Nourishing

archetypes.coreFunction: Compassionately accompany suffering at the limit of cure or control without owning outcome or turning away.

bodySections.heading: Definition
bodySections.content:
The Mature Elder Healer can love what she cannot fix. She brings experience, proportion, ritual, and presence, then releases ownership of the outcome. Her detachment is spacious rather than cold: it lets illness, choice, mystery, and mortality remain larger than her role.

The elder priestess: compassionate wisdom that serves without owning the cure.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- I offer care without claiming the cure.
- Compassion can remain when intervention ends.
- Limits are part of honest healing.
- I meet this person, not only the pattern I recognize.

bodySections.heading: Balance
bodySections.content:
Compassion and Detachment are mutually correcting.

Compassion stays emotionally available to suffering and responds with humane care.

Detachment releases control of outcome, preserving perspective, mystery, and the other's path.

bodySections.heading: Applications
bodySections.content: Stay tender enough to care and detached enough to honor mystery, limits, and death.

bodySections.heading: Gifts, Responsibilities, and Challenges
bodySections.content: The elder priestess: compassionate wisdom that serves without owning the cure.

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- Offer what is yours to give, then release the outcome.
- Notice whether hope is serving the person or your identity as healer.

bodySections.heading: Living as the Witness
bodySections.content: The Mature Elder Healer can love what she cannot fix. She brings experience, proportion, ritual, and presence, then releases ownership of the outcome. Her detachment is spacious rather than cold: it lets illness, choice, mystery, and mortality remain larger than her role.

profile.keyQualities: Cannot conclude care, Makes outcomes personal, Sacrifices health to preserve a healer identity

bodySections.heading: Balance Breakdown
bodySections.content: Compassion martyrs without detachment.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- I must stay until this is healed.
- Stepping back would abandon them.
- A good healer never stops caring.

bodySections.heading: Psychological Mechanics
bodySections.content: Compassion refuses detachment and makes every suffering a personal summons. She overidentifies with pain, continues beyond usefulness, and cannot accept limits, refusal, or death without experiencing them as failures of love.

bodySections.heading: Hidden Energy
bodySections.content: Her devotion becomes profound accompaniment when she can remain loving without controlling the ending.

bodySections.heading: Recognition
bodySections.content:
Cannot conclude care

Makes outcomes personal

Sacrifices health to preserve a healer identity

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- Clarify what is and is not yours to carry.
- Let another person decline or outgrow your help.
- Grieve limits instead of trying to conquer them.

bodySections.heading: Opposite Shadow
bodySections.content: Cynical Healer is the opposite imbalance of Compassion + Detachment.

bodySections.heading: Transformation
bodySections.content: Integration restores Detachment and the dynamic relationship between Compassion and Detachment. Release ownership; remain humanly reachable.

bodySections.heading: Conclusion
bodySections.content: Her devotion becomes profound accompaniment when she can remain loving without controlling the ending.

profile.keyQualities: Reduces people to diagnoses, Withholds warmth as realism, Uses experience to foreclose possibility

bodySections.heading: Balance Breakdown
bodySections.content: Compassion collapses while detachment becomes cynical distance.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- People rarely choose real healing.
- I already know how this story ends.
- Distance is the price of wisdom.

bodySections.heading: Psychological Mechanics
bodySections.content: Compassion recedes into detachment hardened by disappointment. She sees patterns and limits accurately but uses that knowledge to avoid being moved. Experience becomes superiority, and realistic prognosis becomes a defense against encounter.

bodySections.heading: Hidden Energy
bodySections.content: Her realism becomes seasoned equanimity when it protects care from fantasy rather than from feeling.

bodySections.content:

Withholds warmth as realism

Uses experience to foreclose possibility

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- Meet the person before the pattern.
- Offer one sincere act without demanding change.
- Let grief soften what experience has armored.

bodySections.content: Martyred Healer is the opposite imbalance of Compassion + Detachment.

bodySections.heading: Transformation

bodySections.heading: Conclusion
bodySections.content: Her realism becomes seasoned equanimity when it protects care from fantasy rather than from feeling.

archetypes.name: Seer

profile.coreFunction: Voice long-range, seasoned pattern at the time and in the form it can serve.
profile.keyQualities: Attuned, Seasoned, Far-seeing, Cyclic, Gentle, Exact, Listening, Guiding, Patient, Kind

archetypes.coreFunction: Voice long-range, seasoned pattern at the time and in the form it can serve.

bodySections.heading: Definition
bodySections.content:
The Mature Elder Visionary sees long patterns and honors human sequence. She does not use mystery to elevate herself or prediction to control the future. Her counsel arrives in plain language, at a usable scale, and leaves the listener freer to choose.

The elder oracle and moon-seer: long vision seasoned by cycles and consequence.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- I offer the portion of vision this moment can use.
- Silence and speech both answer to service.
- I see patterns without claiming the whole design.
- My counsel returns authority to the listener.

bodySections.heading: Balance
bodySections.content:
Vision and Timing are mutually correcting.

Vision perceives long arcs, hidden relationships, and consequences beyond the immediate frame.

Timing respects readiness, sequence, consent, and the ripeness of action.

bodySections.heading: Applications
bodySections.content: Offer far-seeing truth at the moment and scale where it can become useful.

bodySections.heading: Gifts, Responsibilities, and Challenges
bodySections.content: The elder oracle and moon-seer: long vision seasoned by cycles and consequence.

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- Translate one large pattern into a timely next step.
- Ask whether an insight is yours to speak, now, to this person.

bodySections.heading: Living as the Seer
bodySections.content: The Mature Elder Visionary sees long patterns and honors human sequence. She does not use mystery to elevate herself or prediction to control the future. Her counsel arrives in plain language, at a usable scale, and leaves the listener freer to choose.

profile.keyQualities: Predicts instead of listening, Overloads people with distant implications, Uses mystery to claim authority

bodySections.heading: Balance Breakdown
bodySections.content: Vision intrudes without timing.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- They need to hear the whole truth now.
- Readiness is only resistance.
- My vision exempts me from ordinary context.

bodySections.heading: Psychological Mechanics
bodySections.content: Vision disregards timing. She delivers distant truths before trust, readiness, or context can hold them, then mistakes incomprehension for others' lack of depth. Even accurate insight becomes intrusive when it steals another person's unfolding.

bodySections.heading: Hidden Energy
bodySections.content: Her far sight becomes wise guidance when revelation respects sequence and consent.

bodySections.heading: Recognition
bodySections.content:
Predicts instead of listening

Overloads people with distant implications

Uses mystery to claim authority

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- Ask permission before interpreting another's path.
- Offer the next useful piece, not the whole map.
- Let silence preserve someone else's discovery.

bodySections.heading: Opposite Shadow
bodySections.content: Withholding Seer is the opposite imbalance of Vision + Timing.

bodySections.heading: Transformation
bodySections.content: Integration restores Timing and the dynamic relationship between Vision and Timing. Respect readiness; speak consequential pattern clearly.

bodySections.heading: Conclusion
bodySections.content: Her far sight becomes wise guidance when revelation respects sequence and consent.

bodySections.heading: Balance Breakdown
bodySections.content: Vision collapses while timing becomes indefinite postponement.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- It is not quite the right moment.
- They will see it when they are ready.
- I should not interfere.

bodySections.heading: Psychological Mechanics
bodySections.content: Vision retreats into endless waiting. She recognizes a consequential pattern but postpones speaking until the moment has passed, calling fear discretion. Timing becomes a refuge from the exposure and responsibility of being clear.

bodySections.heading: Hidden Energy
bodySections.content: Her patience becomes mature discernment when it does not abandon the moment that needs her voice.

Confuses noninterference with wisdom

bodySections.heading: Practices

- Name the smallest truth that is timely now.
- Set a threshold beyond which silence becomes neglect.
- Speak plainly and release control of reception.

bodySections.content: Premature Oracle is the opposite imbalance of Vision + Timing.

bodySections.heading: Transformation

bodySections.heading: Conclusion
bodySections.content: Her patience becomes mature discernment when it does not abandon the moment that needs her voice.

archetypes.name: Rebel

profile.coreFunction: Refuse stale or illegitimate authority and build responsible freedom beyond it.
profile.keyQualities: Playful, Subversive, Liberating, Ethical, Quick, Inventive, Insightful, Courageous, Light-hearted, Purposeful

archetypes.coreFunction: Refuse stale or illegitimate authority and build responsible freedom beyond it.

bodySections.heading: Definition
bodySections.content:
The Mature Rebel is loyal to liberation rather than to rebellion itself. She exposes stale norms, disrupts with proportion, and helps build forms that can hold the freedom she seeks. Humor keeps her from sanctimony; responsibility keeps her from making other people pay for her purity.

The revolutionary trickster: liberating disruption, wit, and refusal of stale authority.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- I rebel for a freedom I can help sustain.
- Disruption is a tool, not an identity.
- I answer for the consequences of my refusal.
- I can preserve what works while transforming what does not.

bodySections.heading: Balance
bodySections.content:
Liberation and Responsibility are mutually correcting.

Liberation releases life and agency from domination, inherited limits, or dead forms.

Responsibility accepts impact, interdependence, and the work of building after refusal.

bodySections.heading: Applications
bodySections.content: Break what constrains life and accept responsibility for what the break makes possible.

bodySections.heading: Gifts, Responsibilities, and Challenges
bodySections.content: The revolutionary trickster: liberating disruption, wit, and refusal of stale authority.

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- Name the freedom sought, not only the rule opposed.
- Before disruption, identify who bears the cleanup and transition.

bodySections.heading: Living as the Rebel
bodySections.content: The Mature Rebel is loyal to liberation rather than to rebellion itself. She exposes stale norms, disrupts with proportion, and helps build forms that can hold the freedom she seeks. Humor keeps her from sanctimony; responsibility keeps her from making other people pay for her purity.

profile.keyQualities: Breaks alliances for purity, Escalates without strategy, Leaves others to absorb fallout

bodySections.heading: Balance Breakdown
bodySections.content: Liberation destroys without responsibility.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- Any limit is oppression.
- Disruption is its own success.
- The cause excuses the damage.

bodySections.heading: Psychological Mechanics
bodySections.content: Liberation throws off responsibility and becomes reflexive destruction. She opposes structure for the thrill of rupture, externalizes every consequence, and calls harm inevitable collateral. Freedom remains adolescent because it creates nothing durable.

bodySections.heading: Hidden Energy
bodySections.content: Her refusal becomes catalytic courage when it clears ground for a viable freedom.

bodySections.heading: Recognition
bodySections.content:
Breaks alliances for purity

Escalates without strategy

Leaves others to absorb fallout

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- Define the life-giving alternative before dismantling.
- Take responsibility for foreseeable impact.
- Preserve structures that still serve.

bodySections.heading: Opposite Shadow
bodySections.content: Compliant Critic is the opposite imbalance of Liberation + Responsibility.

bodySections.heading: Transformation
bodySections.content: Integration restores Responsibility and the dynamic relationship between Liberation and Responsibility. Build what freedom requires; act on justified refusal.

bodySections.heading: Conclusion
bodySections.content: Her refusal becomes catalytic courage when it clears ground for a viable freedom.

archetypes.name: Sage

profile.coreFunction: Form and offer sound, revisable counsel from evidence, experience, and reflection.
profile.keyQualities: Wise, Discerning, Curious, Strategic, Calm, Perceptive, Measured, Ethical, Insightful, Practical

archetypes.coreFunction: Form and offer sound, revisable counsel from evidence, experience, and reflection.

bodySections.heading: Definition
bodySections.content:
The Mature Sage is the balanced expression of this pattern—a woman who has metabolized its instincts and gifts into trustworthy presence. In her psyche the raw impulses of sage/wisdom energy have been tempered by discernment and integrated with the rest of her nature. She knows the season she is in, honors limits, and lets life move through her without grasping or collapse. Spiritually, the Mature Sage recognizes that her power is borrowed from something larger—source, nature, community, or mystery—and so she acts with reverence rather than entitlement. She understands how beginnings and endings, growth and rest, assertion and surrender all belong to the same dance.

Strategy, clear counsel, just timing.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- I honor the sage/wisdom within me with wisdom
- I choose truth over comfort and growth over stagnation
- I listen deeply to body, heart, and intuition
- I set clean boundaries and keep gentle promises
- I act from purpose, not from proving or pleasing
- I welcome feedback and repair when I cause harm
- I create beauty and order in ways that nourish life
- I trust cycles—beginnings, middles, endings, and rest

bodySections.heading: Balance
bodySections.content:
Clarity and Curiosity are mutually correcting.

Clarity is essential to the Sage—it channels this archetype’s gifts into meaningful action. Yet clarity is never meant to stand alone. In healthy balance it moves with curiosity, keeping power relational and responsive. This virtue brings the best of the archetype to life without slipping into performance or collapse.

Practically, clarity shows up as clear choices aligned with values. Untethered from curiosity, it can skew toward the Arrogant Know-It-All—pushing, gripping, or overreaching. In rhythm with curiosity, it becomes trustworthy, sustainable, and nourishing for all involved.

Curiosity is essential to the Sage—it channels this archetype’s gifts into meaningful action. Yet curiosity is never meant to stand alone. In healthy balance it moves with clarity, keeping power relational and responsive. This virtue brings the best of the archetype to life without slipping into performance or collapse.

In practice, curiosity provides proportion, pacing, and care. Without clarity, it can drift toward the Withholding Sage—hesitating, second-guessing, or withdrawing. Coupled with clarity, it keeps action timely, humane, and effective.

bodySections.heading: Applications
bodySections.content: Wisdom with warmth; knowledge in service.

bodySections.heading: Gifts, Responsibilities, and Challenges
bodySections.content: Strategy, clear counsel, just timing.

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- "Ask three questions before one claim."
- Pair logic with one embodied check.

bodySections.heading: Living as the Sage
bodySections.content: In the world this looks practical and human. The Mature Sage communicates clearly, takes responsibility for impact, and chooses commitments that match her capacity. She can say yes wholeheartedly and no cleanly. She embodies the sage/wisdom virtues in her work, love, and leadership: not as performance but as natural overflow. Her relationships benefit from her steadiness; her projects benefit from her focus; her body benefits from her pacing. Where the shadow once sought control or hid in avoidance, she now practices humility, accountability, and repair. The result is a grounded confidence that invites trust—and gently calls others into their own maturity.

profile.keyQualities: Oversteps boundaries; decides for others, Mistakes speed for effectiveness, Performs care or genius to avoid vulnerability, Micromanages; cannot rest, Seeks admiration or control over connection, Ignores feedback, doubles down under stress

bodySections.heading: Balance Breakdown
bodySections.content: Clarity hardens without curiosity.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- I stay in control so I never have to feel small.
- I push harder when I feel doubt instead of slowing down.
- I confuse urgency with importance.
- I override my body’s signals to keep things on track.
- I decide what’s best and expect others to catch up.
- I use charm, logic, or pressure when I’m afraid.

bodySections.heading: Psychological Mechanics
bodySections.content:
The Arrogant Know-It-All is the overexpressed shadow of the Sage. She pushes the archetype’s understanding and counsel to an extreme—trying to manufacture certainty, safety, or admiration through control. What begins as discernment, knowledge, strategy becomes performance and pressure. In this stance she overrides signals from body and relationships, doubles down when she should pause, and confuses intensity for truth. Often born from wounds of dismissal, intellectual arrogance around them, she learned to stay ahead of pain by taking charge.

From the outside this shadow can look competent, charismatic, even selfless; inside there is a tightness and a fear that rest or honest contact will expose vulnerability. In decision-making and teaching she speeds up, takes over, and makes unilateral moves “for everyone’s good.” Integration begins when she tells the truth about impact, slows her pace, and lets reciprocity, feedback, and limits restore proportion.

bodySections.heading: Hidden Energy
bodySections.content: When owned, the Arrogant Know-It-All offers decisive energy and the courage to initiate. Tempered by humility, she becomes the Sage’s capacity to move things forward when it truly serves.

bodySections.heading: Recognition
bodySections.content:
Oversteps boundaries; decides for others

Mistakes speed for effectiveness

Performs care or genius to avoid vulnerability

Micromanages; cannot rest

Seeks admiration or control over connection

Ignores feedback, doubles down under stress

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- I pause and feel my body before acting; I let breath slow me down.
- I name the fear underneath my urgency and let someone I trust witness it.
- I ask for consent and co-create next steps instead of taking over as the Sage.
- I replace pressure with clear requests and real timelines.
- I practice letting something be imperfect and still complete.
- I track impact, apologize where needed, and repair.
- I delegate in proportion to others’ capacity and trust their pace.
- I schedule regular rest so power can be sourced, not forced.

bodySections.heading: Opposite Shadow
bodySections.content: Withholding Sage is the opposite imbalance of Clarity + Curiosity.

bodySections.heading: Transformation
bodySections.content: Integration restores Curiosity and the dynamic relationship between Clarity and Curiosity. Reopen the judgment; offer a revisable conclusion.

bodySections.heading: Conclusion
bodySections.content: When owned, the Arrogant Know-It-All offers decisive energy and the courage to initiate. Tempered by humility, she becomes the Sage’s capacity to move things forward when it truly serves.

profile.keyQualities: Defers decisions; waits for perfect certainty, Disengages from body and relationships, People-pleases to avoid conflict, Lets others set terms then resents them, Creativity stalled by perfectionism and fear, Self-doubt presented as humility

bodySections.heading: Balance Breakdown
bodySections.content: Clarity collapses while curiosity becomes endless inquiry.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- I keep quiet so I won’t be wrong.
- I wait for clarity instead of risking a first step.
- I make myself small so others will be comfortable.
- I numb, drift, or fantasize when decisions are needed.
- I defer to experts and ignore my inner knowing.
- I avoid conflict even when a boundary is needed.

bodySections.heading: Psychological Mechanics
bodySections.content:
The Withholding Sage is the underexpressed shadow of the Sage. She retreats from the archetype’s understanding and counsel into fog, passivity, or fantasy. What begins as discernment, knowledge, strategy collapses into avoidance: she waits for a sign, defers to others, and lets fear of misstep become an identity. Wounds of dismissal, intellectual arrogance around them taught her that having needs or a voice was costly, so she learned to disappear.

In practice this looks like hesitation, playing small, or outsourcing choice. In decision-making and teaching she withholds gifts until it’s ‘perfect’ or safe, and resentment builds. Integration begins when she claims a small, honest action, feels feelings without drowning in them, and allows support, structure, and rhythm to rebuild trust in herself.

bodySections.heading: Hidden Energy
bodySections.content: When welcomed, the Withholding Sage offers spaciousness, reflection, and sensitivity. Integrated, she restores the Sage’s ability to listen deeply and act in right timing.

bodySections.heading: Recognition
bodySections.content:

Disengages from body and relationships

People-pleases to avoid conflict

Lets others set terms then resents them

Creativity stalled by perfectionism and fear

Self-doubt presented as humility

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- I choose one small, honest action and complete it today.
- I ground in my body—walk, breathe, hydrate—before making choices.
- I name what I want out loud, allowing the Sage gifts to move.
- I set a simple boundary and keep it.
- I replace rumination with a time-boxed plan and a first step.
- I ask for specific support and stay in relationship while acting.
- I celebrate progress, not perfection, to build momentum.
- I keep gentle promises to myself daily to rebuild trust.

archetypes.name: Storyteller

profile.coreFunction: Carry lived truth across people and time as memorable shared meaning.
profile.keyQualities: Meaningful, Vivid, Source-aware, Contextual, Memorable, Consent-aware, Precise, Integrative, Correctable, Transmissible

archetypes.coreFunction: Carry lived truth across people and time as memorable shared meaning.

bodySections.heading: Definition
bodySections.content:
The Mature Storyteller carries lived truth across people and time. Narrative Imagination gives entrusted experience a memorable shape; Fidelity keeps that shape answerable to source, context, consent, uncertainty, and correction.

She does not merely preserve facts or produce a compelling performance. She selects meaningful detail, creates a finite tellable form, and releases shared meaning without claiming more certainty than the experience can bear.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- I shape lived experience into a form others can remember.
- I distinguish memory, inference, and invention.
- I preserve uncertainty when the record is incomplete.
- I keep source and context visible enough to remain answerable.
- I seek consent before carrying an entrusted account into public space.
- I select vivid detail without making vividness the measure of truth.
- I correct the record when new evidence changes the account.
- I release a finite story without pretending it is the whole story.

bodySections.heading: Balance
bodySections.content:
Narrative Imagination and Fidelity are mutually correcting.

Narrative Imagination finds sequence, image, emphasis, and form so lived experience can travel beyond the original moment. Without Fidelity, it becomes the Exaggerating Dramatist: vividness outruns source, uncertainty disappears, and entrusted experience is bent around the narrator.

Fidelity keeps the telling answerable to what was lived and entrusted. It preserves context, consent, limits, and the possibility of correction. Without Narrative Imagination, Fidelity distorts into the Silent Keeper's impossible completeness and custodial silence.

Together, Narrative Imagination and Fidelity make communal memory both transmissible and trustworthy. The Storyteller shapes enough to be remembered and remains accountable enough to be corrected.

bodySections.heading: Applications
bodySections.content: Carry lived or communal memory in a memorable form that remains answerable to source, context, consent, and correction.

bodySections.heading: Gifts, Responsibilities, and Challenges
bodySections.content: Narrative Imagination creates memorable form. Fidelity protects entrusted truth from distortion, appropriation, false certainty, and context loss.

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- Mark each element as remembered, inferred, or invented before shaping the account.
- Ask what context, consent, uncertainty, and correction the released story must carry.

bodySections.heading: Living as the Storyteller
bodySections.content: Living as the Storyteller means accepting responsibility for what a telling carries forward. She joins Narrative Imagination with Fidelity, gives entrusted experience a finite memorable form, names its limits, and releases it across people and time without betraying its source.

bodySections.heading: Balance Breakdown
bodySections.content: Narrative Imagination dramatizes without Fidelity.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- I improve the account when the lived details feel too quiet.
- I turn inference into fact when it strengthens the arc.
- I collapse uncertainty so the audience will stay with me.
- I center my role in experience entrusted by someone else.
- I repeat a compelling account before checking consent or context.
- I defend the effect of the story instead of correcting its distortion.

bodySections.heading: Psychological Mechanics
bodySections.content:
The Exaggerating Dramatist begins with abundant Narrative Imagination: she can find an arc, vivid detail, emotional emphasis, and a form people will remember. Without Fidelity, those strengths detach from source. Remembered detail, inference, and invention blur; ambiguity is edited out; and another person's entrusted experience becomes material for the narrator's effect.

The causal chain is visible in the telling. Narrative Imagination produces a compelling form, Fidelity checks are skipped, contextual limits disappear, and correction feels like a threat to the performance. Integration restores Fidelity to source, consent, uncertainty, context, and the record.

bodySections.heading: Hidden Energy
bodySections.content: Her retained gift is vivid Narrative Imagination. Joined with Fidelity, it gives entrusted truth a memorable form without making effect more important than source.

bodySections.heading: Recognition
bodySections.content:
Adds connective detail that was not remembered

Turns inference into stated fact

Removes uncertainty to strengthen the arc

Centers the narrator in another person's account

Shares entrusted material without sufficient consent

Protects a compelling version from correction

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- I label each detail as remembered, inferred, or invented.
- I check the account against available sources before release.
- I name uncertainty instead of resolving it for dramatic effect.
- I preserve context that changes the meaning of a vivid moment.
- I secure consent for experience entrusted by another person.
- I remove details that serve the narrator more than the account.
- I invite correction from people close to the source.
- I correct the record as visibly as I released the distortion.

bodySections.heading: Opposite Shadow
bodySections.content: Silent Keeper is the opposite imbalance of Narrative Imagination + Fidelity.

bodySections.heading: Transformation
bodySections.content: Integration restores Fidelity and the dynamic relationship between Narrative Imagination and Fidelity. Restore truth-accountable form; shape and release the entrusted story.

bodySections.heading: Conclusion
bodySections.content: When Fidelity again governs source, context, consent, uncertainty, and correction, Narrative Imagination returns to the Storyteller as memorable form rather than distortion.

bodySections.heading: Balance Breakdown
bodySections.content: Narrative Imagination collapses while Fidelity becomes impossible completeness and custodial silence.

bodySections.heading: Declarations
bodySections.content:
- I refuse to shape the account until every detail is certain.
- I treat any finite telling as a betrayal of what was lived.
- I archive entrusted experience but never make it transmissible.
- I require total permission when bounded consent would suffice.
- I preserve every context until no audience can receive the account.
- I call silence faithful even when communal memory disappears.

bodySections.heading: Psychological Mechanics
bodySections.content:
The Silent Keeper begins with legitimate Fidelity: care for source, privacy, context, consent, and accurate limits. As Narrative Imagination collapses, any selection or sequence feels like distortion. She demands exhaustive completeness and total certainty before allowing a finite account to exist.

Fidelity then becomes custodial silence. Experience is archived but not carried, privacy is treated as a ban on responsible redaction, and communal memory disappears while she waits for a form that omits nothing. Integration restores Narrative Imagination to shape one bounded account whose limits remain explicit.

bodySections.heading: Hidden Energy
bodySections.content: Her retained gift is Fidelity: care for truth, privacy, source, context, and correction. Joined with Narrative Imagination, that care can travel in a form others can receive.

bodySections.heading: Recognition
bodySections.content:
Requires exhaustive certainty before telling

Treats every finite selection as betrayal

Archives entrusted experience without transmission

Confuses privacy with a ban on responsible redaction

Preserves so much context that meaning cannot travel

Calls silence Fidelity despite the loss of memory

bodySections.heading: Practices
bodySections.content:
- I choose one bounded account and define what it can carry.
- I state what is known, uncertain, omitted, and outside scope.
- I secure specific consent or redact identifying detail responsibly.
- I select only the context necessary to preserve meaning.
- I shape a beginning, middle, and end without claiming completeness.
- I set a release point before further preservation becomes silence.
- I invite source-aware correction after release.
- I let Fidelity constrain the form without preventing all form.

bodySections.heading: Opposite Shadow
bodySections.content: Exaggerating Dramatist is the opposite imbalance of Narrative Imagination + Fidelity.

bodySections.heading: Transformation
bodySections.content: Integration restores Narrative Imagination and the dynamic relationship between Narrative Imagination and Fidelity. Restore truth-accountable form; shape and release the entrusted story.

bodySections.heading: Conclusion
bodySections.content: When Narrative Imagination returns, Fidelity no longer requires exhaustive completeness. The Storyteller can release a bounded, source-aware account and remain available for correction.
